title: Knurl v1 per-trial result
description: One dedicated-file trial. concurrency is synchronous pthread worker count, never native async queue depth. Default Linux O_DIRECT or macOS F_NOCACHE is strict cache bypass; buffered mode is explicit. All operations launched before the common deadline are counted, including terminal completions. measured_seconds=max(requested window,last completion-common start). pwrite completion latency is not durable media latency: final fsync and integrity checks are outside the measured window. Latencies time pread/pwrite including partial-I/O retries, excluding deterministic write-buffer generation. Verified means 16 evenly spaced 4096-byte sectors matched seeded offset-based contents before/after; --verify separately checks entire files.

mode.description: Descriptive experiment label; default baseline. Existing gen2/gen3 labels are preserved. Labels do not configure hardware.

latency_ns.description: sum/min/max/mean use unquantized nanosecond samples (clock differences rounded to nearest ns); mean=sum/ops, zero if no operations. Histogram has 1024 bins, 16 per log2 octave: positive sample n has e=floor(log2(n)), s=floor(16*(n-2^e)/2^e), index=16e+s; zero maps bin0. Upper bound(index16e+s)=ceil(2^e*(1+(s+1)/16))-1, saturated at UINT64_MAX. Bin0 includes ns0 and ns1. Nearest-rank P50/P95/P99/P99.9 values are inclusive bin upper bounds, zero for empty samples; relative quantization width at most 6.25% apart from sub-ns rounding. Pool counts across trials/directions to compute pooled percentiles; do not average percentiles.
